verdicts.reason: A keeps the '& Baby Toddler' logo and 'BEDDING' together on one baseline as the original lockup, but everything sits in the top 35%. The bottom ~60% of the canvas is empty navy, and the dot clusters are scattered at random, so the layout is badly lopsided. B has the same empty bottom and also breaks the brand lockup: 'BEDDING' drops below the logo and floats off to the right with no shared alignment. Its stray dot grid on the right edge makes the arrangement look even more arbitrary.
